assumptions: Baseline stated values chosen from ILLUSTRATIVE data-sheet ranges: liquid fill_fraction 0.85 (mid of 0.70-0.95; line had drained toward tank for about 8 h after XV-101 closed so not liquid-full, but was a transfer line in service shortly before so mostly liquid) and sound-VIP heat_leak_W_m 2 (mid of 1-3 W/m for a sound vacuum jacket). Sensitivity runs at fills 0.70/0.95 and heat leaks 1/3/10/20/30 W/m show dependence.

Hours = 120 in the baseline run is the multi-day blocked-in horizon solved; the data sheet gives the block-in start (3 June 2022 16:44, NOPV p.3) but no public segment length, pipe spec, design pressure or exact failure time, all marked ILLUSTRATIVE where applicable. Length 100 m is ILLUSTRATIVE and pressure history is length-independent because trapped mass and heat leak both scale with length (data sheet).

Composition is ILLUSTRATIVE lean Gulf Coast LNG from the data sheet (methane 0.95, ethane 0.035, propane 0.010, nitrogen 0.005 mole fraction); DWSIM compound names Methane/Ethane/Propane/Nitrogen used.

Pipe/design/burst/PSV set are ILLUSTRATIVE documented values, not raised or altered: NPS 18 Sch 10S 457.2 mm OD x 4.78 mm wall; design 230 psig (ASME B16.5 Class 150 304L basis stated in data sheet); estimated burst 1456 psig (Barlow/70 ksi 304L basis stated in data sheet); PSV-101 set equal to design 230 psig.

As-documented safeguard state is modelled: XV-101 closed, XV-102 closed, PSV-101 isolated=true representing HV-101 left closed after the 26 April 2022 PSV test. Counterfactual runs only change PSV isolated=false or XV-102 closed=false; no limits were edited.
